name: Black Balsam
about: Black Balsam is a herbal liqueur from Latvia. It is a national drink that Riga is known for.
tip: Check that the bottle is the original strength.

name: Latvian mittens
about: Latvian mittens are hand-knitted wool gloves with traditional patterns. They reflect the country's long knitting culture.
tip: Check that they are hand-knitted and see how much wool they contain.

name: Baltic amber
where: Amber shops in the Old Town
about: Baltic amber is fossilized tree resin found along the Baltic Sea coast. Riga is a well-known place to buy it.
tip: Make sure the amber is natural before you buy.
